import { Injectable, Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Processor, WorkerHost } from '@nestjs/bullmq';
import { Job } from 'bullmq';

const JobNames = {
  Sync: 'sync-report',
  Cleanup: 'cleanup-report',
} as const;

@Injectable()
class IfWorkService {
  async sync(_id: string): Promise<void> {}
  async cleanup(_id: string): Promise<void> {}
  async unmatched(_id: string): Promise<void> {}
}

// B0_CASE:if-complete
@Processor('if-reports')
class SafeIfProcessor extends WorkerHost {
  constructor(private readonly work: IfWorkService) {
    super();
  }

  async process(job: Job<{ readonly id: string }, unknown, string>): Promise<void> {
    // B0_BRANCH:if-left-exact
    if (job.name === JobNames.Sync) {
      await this.work.sync(job.data.id);
      return;
    }
    // B0_BRANCH:if-right-exact
    if (JobNames.Cleanup === job.name) {
      await this.work.cleanup(job.data.id);
      return;
    }
    // B0_BRANCH:if-unmatched-fallthrough
    await this.work.unmatched(job.data.id);
  }
}

@Module({ providers: [IfWorkService, SafeIfProcessor] })
class SafeIfModule {}

const __B0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__ = (() => {
  throw new Error('B0 BullMQ fixture must never execute: if-safe');
})();
void __B0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__;
